Does Phagian's special ("Any vampire you control may play cards that
require Necromancy at the basic level, with the cost increased by 1
blood") override any other reqirement? This currently only affects two
cards: Friend of Mine and Gear Up. If the Necromancy card has some
other/additional requirement, does Phagian's special also override that
requirement?

Not that I forsee myself suddenly being willing to pay two blood for
the Necromancy version of Friend of Mine, but I thought I'd ask.

cmb
